intro: Kazakhstan is the ninth-largest country in the world, mostly steppe and desert, with high mountains in the south-east.

chapters.title: Steppe and mountains
text: Grassy steppe covers the north, and deserts the centre and south. The Tian Shan and Altai mountains rise in the south-east, where Khan Tengri reaches about 7,000 m.
Kazakhstan borders the Caspian Sea in the west and shares the shrinking Aral Sea with Uzbekistan.

chapters.title: Extreme climate
text: Being so far from the oceans, Kazakhstan has very cold winters and hot summers. Astana is one of the coldest capitals in the world.

keyTerms.meaning: A lake that shrank after rivers were diverted for farming.
